description: Source code for the Elasticsearch indexing job worker in Mattermost, including worker initialization, job processing, batch indexing, progress tracking, and entity indexing logic.

classes.name: IndexerWorker
classes.description: Worker responsible for indexing entities into Elasticsearch, managing job lifecycle, batching, and progress tracking.

classes.name: IndexingProgress
classes.description: Tracks progress of indexing process, including counts, timestamps, and completion status for posts, channels, users, and files.

methods.name: CurrentProgress
methods.description: Calculates overall progress percentage based on completed entities.

methods.name: IsDone
methods.description: Determines if the indexing job is complete based on progress and job data.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker loop, processing jobs and batching index operations.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the worker gracefully, waiting for ongoing processes to finish.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel for submitting jobs to the worker.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the worker is enabled based on license and configuration.

methods.name: initEntitiesToIndex
methods.description: Initializes which entities (posts, channels, users, files) to index based on job data.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Claims and processes a single indexing job, managing batching, progress, and error handling.

methods.name: IndexBatch
methods.description: Processes a batch of entities (posts, channels, users, files) for indexing.

methods.name: IndexPostsBatch
methods.description: Fetches and indexes a batch of posts for indexing.

methods.name: BulkIndexPosts
methods.description: Indexes a batch of posts into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: IndexFilesBatch
methods.description: Fetches and indexes a batch of files for indexing.

methods.name: BulkIndexFiles
methods.description: Indexes a batch of files into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: IndexChannelsBatch
methods.description: Fetches and indexes a batch of channels.

methods.name: BulkIndexChannels
methods.description: Indexes a batch of channels into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: IndexUsersBatch
methods.description: Fetches and indexes a batch of users.

methods.name: BulkIndexUsers
methods.description: Indexes a batch of users into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: initProgress
methods.description: Initializes progress tracking for a job, parsing start/end times and counts.

methods.name: parseStartTime
methods.description: Parses and sets the start time for indexing from job data or defaults.

methods.name: parseEndTime
methods.description: Parses and sets the end time for indexing from job data.

methods.name: parseDoneCount
methods.description: Parses progress counts from job data.

methods.name: setStartEntityIDs
methods.description: Sets initial entity IDs for progress tracking from job data.

methods.name: entityCountFallback
methods.description: Provides fallback counts for entities if analytics queries fail.

methods.name: setEntityCount
methods.description: Sets total entity counts for progress tracking, with fallback on errors.
